title: Risk management value prevention SME blog hero
subject: A calm German SME workshop table in soft daylight: an open paper risk map, a notebook and a mug, no alarm or disaster mood — overview instead of panic.
context: Beraterium standalone blog hero (DE/EN) on why early risk management creates clarity rather than scare tactics. Professional B2B editorial, not stock photo.

platform_website.optimized_variants_en: Build creates {slug}-hero.webp plus -480w, -960w, -1440w responsive WebP from the PNG source
platform_website.best_practice_notes_en: Wide 16:9 hero for article header; single clear focal point; generous negative space in upper third; motif readable at thumbnail and at full 1440px width.
platform_website.safe_zone_en: Keep main subject in central 90% width; avoid critical detail in extreme left/right 5% and bottom 10% except the small AI-disclosure label bottom right.

composition.depth: foreground mug and notebook, midground open risk map on table, background quiet office window light

lighting.style: soft natural window light with gentle cinematic falloff

style.mood: thoughtful, credible, professionally calm — not alarmist

optional_text_overlay.typography_en: Prefer no text on image — article H1 renders above hero.
optional_text_overlay.prompt_instruction_en: Prefer no text on image except the small AI-disclosure label bottom right.

negative_prompt: no watermarks or text except the small AI-disclosure label bottom right
no identifiable real persons or celebrities
no fire, sirens, panic faces, red alert screens

seo.alt_text: Calm SME workshop table with an open risk map and notebook in soft daylight, no alarm mood
seo.caption: Early risk management as calm overview, not scare tactics.
seo.image_title: Why risk management matters - clarity not panic

generation_prompt_single_block_en: Editorial landscape photograph 1920x1080 16:9, clean editorial realism. Calm German SME workshop table in soft window light from the left, navy charcoal and pale grey palette with a small cyan or amber accent (hex #1F2A44, #00A3FF, #F2B134, #F5F7FA). Open paper risk map and notebook in the centre, mug in the foreground, quiet office in the background. Mood: trustworthy, focused, calm overview — not alarm. No people or unidentifiable blur of people. No fire, sirens, red alerts. No third-party logos. Small legible caption text 'KI-generiertes Bild' in the bottom-right corner: small clean sans-serif, white at about 70 percent opacity on a dark navy rounded badge, unobtrusive but readable at thumbnail size. Keep the main subject in the central 90 percent; generous negative space in the upper third.

post_processing_fallback.when: Falls Generator Logo oder KI-Vermerk unleserlich weglasst
post_processing_fallback.ki_label_position: bottom-right, white text on dark navy rounded badge (#1F2A44, ~70% opacity)

ai_disclosure.placement: small legible label in the bottom-right corner of the image
ai_disclosure.prompt_instruction: Exact caption 'KI-generiertes Bild' bottom-right on dark navy badge, readable at thumbnail size.
